about_the_game:
Defeat roaming bands of enemies and bosses, answering trivia questions. Answer correctly, unleash attacks on your foes. Answer incorrectly and suffer the fate of adventurers that came before.

Collect loot, gain experience, and power up in an effort to gain the upper hand in this trivia based roguelike RPG.

Bring a trivial-loving friend and play online co-op together, or get a few friends together and play the PvP arena duel. Last hero standing wins!

Features

  • Singleplayer and Multiplayer Trivia Madness
  • Class based character select impacts how you play
  • Robust loot system impacts all aspects of the trivia engine
  • Add your own categories and questions whenever you want
  • Coming soon! Wishlist / Join Mailing list to follow development

(This is a WIP title, expect this page and the following playtests to evolve significantly before release)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM / Direct X 10+ Support
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Your actions are dictated by trivia questions and answers in this roguelike RPG with a trivia twist. Collect loot and level up to impact your chances of survival, take down dangerous foes and defeat the evil Trivia Arch Lich.
